checks.name: invalid_input_keeps_live
checks.code:
from config_store import *
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d)/'config';write_config(p,{'a':1});old=p.read_bytes()
 try:write_config(p,{'bad':set()})
 except (TypeError,ValueError):pass
 else:raise AssertionError('invalid accepted')
 assert p.read_bytes()==old

from config_store import *
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile,json
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d)/'config';write_config(p,{'a':1});write_config(p,{'a':2});assert json.loads((Path(d)/'config.bak').read_text())=={'a':1};p.write_text('{broken');assert read_config(p)=={'a':1}

checks.name: both_corrupt_fail
checks.code:
from config_store import *
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d)/'config';p.write_text('{bad');p.with_name('config.bak').write_text('{bad')
 try:read_config(p)
 except (ValueError,OSError):pass
 else:raise AssertionError('corrupt accepted')
